mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ means that the nature of a thing would only be made manifest after a developmental period.
Becoming means that the nature of a thing would only be made manifest after a developmental period.

Fill in the blank: ______ are the society's construction and as such everyone is born to learn how to behave as a man or as a woman according to specific and peculiar customs that vary from time to time and from place to place.

Gender roles are the society's construction and as such everyone is born to learn how to behave as a man or as a woman according to specific and peculiar customs that vary from time to time and from place to place.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a theory that argues that women are weaker and inferior to men.
Sexism is a theory that argues that women are weaker and inferior to men.

Fill in the blank: ______ is concerned with the nature and essence of the female sex and with the question of whether the female sex, as a human person, has been misrepresented as being with a nature inferior to that of the male.

Feminist metaphysics is concerned with the nature and essence of the female sex and with the question of whether the female sex, as a human person, has been misrepresented as being with a nature inferior to that of the male.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a free citizen whereas the slave is not a free citizen.
The master is a free citizen whereas the slave is not a free citizen.
fib: ______ refers to the preference one have for either having a relationship with a fellow man or a fellow woman or having a relationship with the opposite sex.
Sexuality refers to the preference one have for either having a relationship with a fellow man or a fellow woman or having a relationship with the opposite sex.
______ is the same as gender epistemology.
Feminist epistemology is the same as gender epistemology.
______ refers to the process of changing of one's sex.
Transgender refers to the process of changing of one's sex.
